Name: Hxnrik's RuneScape Accessories
Author: Hxnrikkk
Description:
These are not items you can purchase, these are a FS (Fashion Sense) Pack. That way you can still wear your regular gear, and put these awesome accessories on top! Pierre's General Store sells a Hand Mirror, which you'll need to purchase. Use it and click through your new options! You'll find the Capes under 'Accessories', the Party Hats under 'Hats', and the Dragon Boots under 'Boots'. Pretty self explanatory. 

[b][i][u]Important:
[/u][/i][/b]When downloading the mod, you'll get a file containing 2 files; one beginning with [CP], and one [FS]. Extract both and place them into your mod folder.
